wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D CROSS-TIER HIGH-YIELD PREFLIGHT 3
phase: Bounded metadata re-ranking (Tier 1 dedicated-performance identities cross-ranked with Tier 2 civic-hall large/medium/small designations) and current/current-linked first-party evidence preflight only
scopeBoundary: The remaining unresearched Tokyo Priority-D inventory was re-ranked from repository metadata alone, using the same cross-tier rule as the two prior TOKYO PRIORITY D CROSS-TIER HIGH-YIELD PREFLIGHT waves (2026-08-26): dedicated theater/theatre/concert-hall/auditorium/講堂 identities and civic/public-hall 大ホール/中ホール/小ホール/主ホール/メインホール-designated spaces are cross-ranked on equal footing, using evidence-locatability tie-break signals (source-located, likely-eligible, direct operator URL, recorded capacity) with a yield penalty for studio/training/rehearsal/live-spot/live-house/multipurpose/meeting/movable/free-seating/sub-100-seat wording. Current/current-linked first-party evidence was checked for the top five ranked candidates in order. Research stopped at the five-candidate ceiling with 0 ADOPT, short of the three-ADOPT stop condition. No two-pass transcription, source or range authoring, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or production-total change was made.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked first-party issuer evidence that fixes, without inference, one representative configuration with a complete issuer-numbered seat set, issuer-defined row/block/floor/category ownership, a configuration boundary, and the treatment of accessibility, removable, and alternative configurations, so that an independent two-pass transcription can reproduce it losslessly. This wave additionally required cross-checking any numbered seat chart against every other current/current-linked first-party material from the same issuer (facility page, capacity table, hall guide, floor plan, usage guide, accessibility note); where floor subtotal, total capacity, wheelchair count, removable seats, or configuration scope differ across documents, the relationship must be explainable from issuer evidence, and total-only agreement is not sufficient (per the tokyo-official-0249 Scott Hall precedent). DEFER covers a missing or incomplete printed ID set, an approximate/maximum-only capacity statement, or an explicitly movable/free-seating space whose current material discloses no fixed numbered configuration. HARD-CASE DEFER is reserved for an otherwise complete numbered chart whose issuer subtotal, floor ownership, accessibility relation, or an unexplained marking alone remains unreconciled. Capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry-derived ownership, configuration mixing, assigning IDs to unnumbered wheelchair spaces, and arbitrary deletion of printed IDs are prohibited. An HTTP-only current official issuer is not by itself a DEFER/HOLD reason; no candidate in this wave required the httpOnlyOfficial waiver because HTTPS worked throughout (one candidate's dedicated PDF and one candidate's detail sub-page returned 404, which is a currentness/availability finding, not a transport finding).

researchOrder.currentness: Current: both the facility page and the about-us page were fetched live on 2026-08-26 and returned normal content with no closure/renovation notice.
researchOrder.selectedRepresentativeConfiguration: Single standard configuration (159-seat, non-stage-expanded), rows A-L with left/center/right blocks per the seating-chart image; the 145-seat stage-expanded alternate configuration is disclosed in text only, with no separate chart.
researchOrder.numberedSeatEvidence: Complete for the 159-seat standard configuration. Rows A,C,E,G,I,K (6 rows): left 11-13 (3), center 4-10 (7), right 1-3 (3) = 13 each, 78 total. Rows B,D,F,H,J (5 rows): left 12-14 (3), center 4-11 (8), right 1-3 (3) = 14 each, 70 total. Row L (1 row, adjacent to ENTRANCE/ENTRADA, no left block): center 4-11 (8), right 1-3 (3) = 11. Independently summed: 78 + 70 + 11 = 159, matching the facility page's own printed 159 exactly.
researchOrder.rowBlockFloorOwnership: Single floor, 12 rows (A-L), each row's left/center/right block boundary drawn directly on the printed chart; row L is the only row with no left block (confirmed at 4x magnification against the entrance-area geometry).
researchOrder.issuerSubtotalPublishedCapacity: 159席（ステージ拡張時145席）on the dedicated facility page, matching the independently summed chart total exactly.
researchOrder.crossDocumentReconciliation: The dedicated facility page's precise 159/145 figures were cross-checked against the current 'about the center' overview page, which states the building contains 約200人収容できるホール (a hall accommodating approximately 200 people) among its facilities. No issuer document explains the relation between the chart's exact 159 and this separate page's approximate ~200 figure (e.g. standing-room/reception capacity, an outdated figure, or a different combined space) — per the tokyo-official-0249 Scott Hall precedent, an unexplained cross-document capacity gap is not resolved merely because one figure is hedged as approximate ('約'), and total-only or rounding-based reasoning alone is not reconciliation evidence.
researchOrder.wheelchairAccessibility: Not disclosed on the facility page or the about-us page; no wheelchair/accessibility keyword was found anywhere in either page's decoded HTML.
researchOrder.removableAuxiliaryAlternateConfiguration: A distinct 145-seat 'stage expanded' alternate configuration is disclosed in text on the facility page, but no separate chart for it was published; it was not evaluated further since the primary 159-seat configuration already carries an unresolved cross-document capacity conflict.
researchOrder.httpsHttpTransport: HTTPS works for every checked page and the chart image; no waiver applicable.
researchOrder.dispositionReason: A complete, internally consistent 159-seat numbered chart exists and matches the dedicated facility page's own printed subtotal exactly, but a separate current official page from the same issuer states an approximate ~200-person capacity for the same hall with no issuer-published relation between the two figures (standing room, historical figure, or otherwise). Neither retaining the chart's 159 while ignoring the ~200 statement, nor treating '約200' as a benign rounding of 159, is supportable without an issuer-stated relation.
researchOrder.hardCaseSpecificEvidenceRequirement: A current issuer statement (facility page revision, hall guide, or FAQ) explaining what the approximately 200-person figure refers to relative to the dedicated chart's exact 159/145 seated configuration — e.g. an explicit standing-room/reception-capacity distinction, or a correction to one of the two figures.
